name: facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tutorials/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.run_audio_simulation: run a habitat-sim simulator with an audio sensor to capture binaural audio observations in a 3D scene
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.create_acoustics_config: create an RLRAudioPropagationConfiguration with materials enabled for realistic audio propagation simulation
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.configure_channel_layout: configure a binaural channel layout with two channels for stereo audio sensor output
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.add_audio_sensor: add an AudioSensorSpec to the simulator with acoustics config and channel layout settings
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.get_sensor_observations: get audio sensor observations from the simulator and print or write impulse response data

facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.run_lighting_tutorial: run the lighting tutorial to demonstrate scene lighting configurations in Habitat-Sim simulator
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.create_light_setup: create a custom light setup using LightInfo with vector and LightPositionModel for the simulator
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.configure_simulator_with_lighting: configure the Habitat-Sim simulator with a custom scene light setup and override defaults
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.place_rigid_objects: place rigid objects like spheres and chairs in the scene using the object template manager
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.modify_existing_light_setup: modify an existing light setup by retrieving it and adding additional lights before re-registering

facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.run_semantic_id_tutorial: run the habitat sim semantic ID tutorial to render RGB and semantic camera observations
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.create_simulator_configuration: create a habitat sim configuration with RGB and semantic camera sensor specs
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.place_agent_in_scene: place an agent at a specific position and rotation in the habitat sim scene
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.render_sensor_observations: render and optionally display RGB and semantic camera observations from the simulator
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/examples/tu.set_object_semantic_ids: set semantic IDs on rigid objects and their visual scene nodes in habitat sim
